description: This file defines a set of React functional components for creating UI card components, including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter. These components provide a configurable and styled container for displaying content in a consistent UI pattern within a React application.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A flexible surface container component with optional header, content, and footer.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: A container for the header section of the card, typically containing titles or action buttons.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: A component for rendering the title within a card, customizable with different HTML tags.

methods.name: CardDescription
methods.description: A component for displaying a description or supplementary text in the card.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: A container for the main content area of the card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: A footer area for additional actions or information at the bottom of the card.
